name: Izumi Saki
source:
“If I died–– would you cry for me?”

A student who seems to get involved in a lot of accidents and get injured frequently, so is often absent from school. He finds it hard to show his emotions on his face, but contrary to his small, meek appearance he has a sharp tongue and a dry sense of humour. He’s also fond of pranks, but he’s often misunderstood by others, and has ended up with the impression of being difficult to get along with. He’s a big eater and loves using his mobile phone, and is a fickle troublemaker.
He’s cocky towards Tsujimura, but is weak to Kuboya.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
